description:
Float at least {12} in your mana pool.
Activate Doubling Cube by paying {3} and tapping it, adding at least {9}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Doubling Cube to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Sword of the Paruns' equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to Doubling Cube.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Doubling Cube.
Activate Doubling Cube by paying {3} and tapping it, adding at least {8}.
